layout_dets.text: A cyclist rides in a straight line for 20 minutes. He waits for half an hour, then returns in a straight line to his

layout_dets.text: (c) Work out the average speed for the whole journey.

layout_dets.text: A woman travels at a speed of 20 m/s for half an hour before she stops for grocery shopping. After

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: minutes.

layout_dets.text: (a) Calculate the speed of the driver for the last part of the journey. Express your answer in m/s.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (b)Calculate the average speed of the car, in m/s, for the whole journey.
